response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, s.gbsize / s.spanmin AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0), project_rates AS (SELECT arcref, fundflux, AVG(rate) AS project_rate FROM scan_rates GROUP BY arcref, fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(project_rate) AS benchmark_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT p.arcref, p.fundflux, p.project_rate, p.project_rate - b.benchmark_rate AS gap FROM project_rates p CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE p.project_rate > b.benchmark_rate ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
